items.source:
The StreamingModel interface provides a generic API for invoking an AI models with
streaming response. It abstracts the process of sending requests and receiving a
streaming responses. The interface uses Java generics to accommodate different types of
requests and responses, enhancing flexibility and adaptability across different AI
model implementations.
items.translation: StreamingModel 接口提供了一个通用的 API，用于调用具有流式响应功能的 AI 模型。该接口抽象了发送请求和接收流式响应的过程。通过使用 Java 泛型，该接口能够适配不同类型的请求和响应，从而增强了在不同 AI 模型实现中的灵活性和适应性。

items.source: TReq - the generic type of the request to the AI model
items.translation: TReq - AI 模型请求的泛型类型

items.source: TResChunk - the generic type of a single item in the streaming response from the AI model
items.translation: TResChunk - AI 模型流式响应中单个项目的泛型类型

items.source: request - the request object to be sent to the AI model
items.translation: request - 要发送给 AI 模型的请求对象

items.source: the streaming response from the AI model
